chapter.verse: “Kei pen lenggui taktak ka hi a, ka Pa pen lenggui loneipa ahi hi.
Amah in kei' sunga gah a neilo hiang khempeuh satkhia a, gah a nei hiangte a gah semsem nadingin hah hi.
Note pen kong gensa thu hangin a siang khinsa na hi uh hi.

Kei' sungah omkip unla kei zong note' sungah kong omkip ding hi. Lenggui hiang pen lenggui sungah omkip keileh ama' thu-in gah nei theilo ahih mah bangin note zong kei' sungah na omkip kei uhleh gah na nei thei kei ding uh hi.

Kei pen lenggui ka hi a, note pen a hiang na hi uh hi. Kei' sungah a omkip peuhpeuh kei zong ama' sungah ka omkip ding a, amah in gah tampi nei ding hi. A hang pen kei tawh lo-in bangmah na hih thei kei ding uh hi.
Mi khatpeuh kei' sungah a omkip keileh lenggui hiang bangin kipaai-in keugaw ding hi. Tua lenggui hiangte kikaikhawmin meikhuk ah kikhul ding a, kangtum ding uh hi.
Kei' sungah note omkipin note' sungah ka thu a omkip nakleh na deih peuhpeuh uh ngen un; note' ading hong kisepsak ding hi.
Note in gah tampi nei-in keima' nungzui na hihlam uh na kilatsak uh ciangin ka Pa in minpha a ngah ahi hi.
Pa in kei hong it bangin kei zong note kong it hi. Keima' itna sungah omkip un.
Ka Pa' thupiaknate zui-in ama' hong itna sungah ka omkip bangin note in ka thupiaknate na zuih uhleh kong itna sungah na omkip ding uh hi.
Keima' nuamna note' sungah a om theih nadingin leh note' nuamna a kicin theih nadingin hih thute hong gen ka hi hi.
“Ka thupiakna hih bang ahi hi: Note kong it mah bangin note zong khatlekhat na ki-it un.
A lawmte' ading a nuntakna a pia mipa' sangin itna lianzaw a nei kuamah om lo hi.
Kong thupiakna na zuih uhleh note pen ka lawmte na hi uh hi.

Note, sila kong ci nawnkei ding hi; a hang pen sila in a topa' septe theihpih lo hi. Ahi zongin note pen lawmte kong ci khinzo hi. A hang pen ka Pa' kiangpan ka zak thu khempeuh note kong theisak khinzo hi.

Note in kei nong teel kei uh a, ahi zongin note va pai-in gah nei-in tua na gahte uh a kip nading leh tua tungtawnin keima' min tawh Pa' kiangah na nget peuhpeuh uh Pa in hong piak theih nadingin keimah in note hong tengkhia-in hong seh ka hi hi.
Hih kong thupiakte pen note khatlekhat na ki-it nading uh ahi hi.
“Leitung in note hong muhdah leh note' ma-in kei hong mudah khin uh cih na thei un.

Leitung tawh a kisawh hileh uhcin leitung in zong ama' pawlte bangin note hong it ding hi. Ahi zongin leitung pan note kong tengkhia a, leitung tawh kisawh lo na hih manun tua thu hangin leitung in note hong mudah hi.

Note' kianga kong gen thu phawk un: ‘Sila khat a topa sangin lianzaw lo hi.’ Amaute in kei hong bawlsiat uhleh note zong hong bawlsia ding uh a, ka thu a zuih uhleh note' thu zong hong zui ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in kei hong sawlpa thei lo uh ahih manin keima' min hangin hih thute khempeuh note' tungah hong bawl ding uh hi.
Kei hong pai lo-in amaute' tungah thu gen lo hi le-ing amaute mawhbaang lo ding uh a, ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh a mawhnate uhah paulap nei nawnlo uh hi.
Kei hong mudah peuhpeuh ka Pa zong a mudah ahi hi.
Midang kuama' bawlloh nasepte amaute' lakah a bawllo hi le-ing amaute mawhbaang lo ding uh a, ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh amaute in mu uh a, kei leh ka Pa ka nihun hong mudah uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' Thukhun sunga a kigelh thu, ‘Thusiksan om lo pi-in kei hong mudah uh hi,’ a cih pen a tangtun kul ahi hi.
“Ahi zongin Pa' kiangpana kong sawl ding, Pa' kiangpan hong kizomsuak, thumaan thutak Kha ahi, Huhpa hong tun ciangin keima' thu teci hong pang ding hi.
A kipatcil pan kei tawh omkhawm na hih manun note in zong teci na pang ding uh hi.
